caption:
A year after he gave up his first command for letting a carrier slip past, Cmdr. Joseph Enright found another one on his radar south of Japan. It was a ship the Americans did not even know existed, and he would have to chase it all night.

Read it free: https://ww2dispatches.substack.com/p/the-night-chase-for-shinano
